SessionStart.name: aemu-session-start
SessionStart.description: Initializes the per-conversation AEMU Harness Session Ledger.

PreInvocation.name: aemu-workflow-context-injector
PreInvocation.description: Injects active emu-dev-cli workflow steps and tracked running emulator instances into the prompt context.

hooks.name: aemu-git-gerrit-guardrail
hooks.description: Enforces Semantic Commit Message rules on direct git commits and --notify=OWNER on Gerrit review mutations.

hooks.name: aemu-session-ledger-tracker
hooks.description: Tracks launched/stopped emulator instances and workflow state transitions in the conversation ledger.

Stop.name: aemu-workflow-continuation-guard
Stop.description: Automatically continues active RUNNING emu-dev-cli workflows (up to 3 turns) before allowing the agent to stop.
